tcoSource: Source: [Edmunds 2025 Model Y True Cost to Own](https://www.edmunds.com/tesla/model-y/2025/cost-to-own/) as analog (2026-specific TCO not yet published — Edmunds 2026 MY page shows Data Unavailable for most trims as of May 2026). 5-year, 15,000 mi/yr. **Substitution note**: Tesla renamed the 2026 Model Y lineup to Standard / Premium / Performance. The 2026 Standard RWD (MSRP $39,990) is a new value trim below the prior Long Range. Depreciation ($26,200) and financing ($7,000) scaled down from the 2025 LR RWD baseline ($29,523 dep / $7,900 fin) in proportion to the lower MSRP (~$39,990 vs ~$44,990). Insurance, maint, repairs, fuel held to 2025 LR RWD figures (same architecture, same insurer profile). Cross-checked against [CarEdge Model Y cost-to-own](https://caredge.com/tesla/model-y/cost-to-own).
